en.headline: Police hunt 38-year-old man after kitchen-knife assault at Tuen Mun NOVO LAND
en.dek: A 23-year-old woman sustained a forehead wound and leg bruises in an alleged attack by her partner early on Tuesday; officers seized a 20cm knife and classified the case as assault occasioning actual bodily harm.
body: Police are searching for a 38-year-old man after an alleged assault with a kitchen knife at a flat in NOVO LAND, Yan Po Road, Tuen Mun, on Tuesday morning.

Officers received a report from security staff at about 7.36am. They attended and recovered a kitchen knife about 20 centimetres long. The 23-year-old woman, who remained conscious, had a roughly 2-centimetre cut to her forehead and bruises to her legs; she was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital.

Police said preliminary inquiries indicated the man, understood to be the woman's partner, attacked her inside the unit during a dispute before leaving the scene. The case has been classified as assault occasioning actual bodily harm and handed to Tuen Mun District Crime Investigation Team 1. No arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 屯門NOVO LAND廚刀襲擊案 警方追緝38歲男子
zh.dek: 23歲女子前額有約2厘米刀傷及腳部瘀傷，案件列作襲擊致造成身體傷害，屯門警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方正追緝一名38歲男子，涉嫌周二早上在屯門欣寶路NOVO LAND一個單位內，用廚房刀襲擊其23歲女友。
保安約早上7時36分報案，警員到場後檢獲一把長約20厘米的廚房刀。女子清醒，前額有約2厘米刀傷，雙腳有瘀傷，已送屯門醫院治理。
警方初步調查相信，該名男子在爭執期間於單位內襲擊女友後逃去。案件列作襲擊致造成身體傷害，交由屯門警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
